title: Orbit reaches the completed state
statement: Let $g$ be a map on finite bit strings that is the step map determined by update and next-state maps. If $p$ is nonempty and the $K$th iterate of $g$ from $s_0$ is the pair encoding of $p$ and the pair encoding of the empty string with $q$, then every iterate with index $i>K$ equals the completed-block string.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is the step map determined by maps $\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt}:\{0,1\}^*\times\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$
